narration:0:1721701001:1.text: After parting ways with Merlin, Gwyneth returns to the base with a heavy secret weighing on her heart.
narration:0:1721701001:1.male: After parting ways with Merlin, Gwyneth returns to the base with a heavy secret weighing on her heart.
narration:0:1721701001:1.female: After parting ways with Merlin, Gwyneth returns to the base with a heavy secret weighing on her heart.

narration:1:1721701002:1.text: As she changes back into her guard uniform, she begins contemplating her next move...
narration:1:1721701002:1.male: As she changes back into her guard uniform, she begins contemplating her next move...
narration:1:1721701002:1.female: As she changes back into her guard uniform, she begins contemplating her next move...

narration:2:1721701003:1.text: Her thoughts remain occupied by what she encountered in the Silken Snare's kitchen—the spiders, the dragon eggs... and Voracia. How is she supposed to uncover her schemes and put a stop to them?
narration:2:1721701003:1.male: Her thoughts remain occupied by what she encountered in the Silken Snare's kitchen—the spiders, the dragon eggs... and Voracia. How is she supposed to uncover her schemes and put a stop to them?
narration:2:1721701003:1.female: Her thoughts remain occupied by what she encountered in the Silken Snare's kitchen—the spiders, the dragon eggs... and Voracia. How is she supposed to uncover her schemes and put a stop to them?

say:1:1721702001:1.text: Gwyneth, I'm sorry I couldn't make it... Something urgent came up, and I couldn't get away.
say:1:1721702001:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝，关于今天……我很抱歉。临时有紧急公务绊住了脚...

say:2:1721702002:1.text: No worries, Commander. Duty comes first. I trust you have your reasons, just as you do for keeping me off the investigation.
say:2:1721702002:1.source_cn: 没关系，司令。身为军人，任务优先。我能理解您的苦衷，就...

say:3:1721702003:1.text: I know you're upset. To make it up to you, I'll grant any request you have, except for joining the investigation.
say:3:1721702003:1.source_cn: 我知道你在生气。作为补偿，除了让你涉险去调查圣古堂消失...

say:4:1721702004:1.text: Really? Very well. Please issue an immediate order to seal and search the <style="highlight">Silken Snare</style>, as well as detain its proprietor, Voracia.
say:4:1721702004:1.source_cn: 真的吗？那好。既然您不让我调查，那就请您立刻下令——封...

say:5:1721702005:2.text: Why? Did something happen while you were there?
say:5:1721702005:2.source_cn: 什么，查封丝绒陷阱？今天发生什么事了吗？

say:6:1721702006:2.text: I... slipped into the kitchen... and found some illegal ingredients...
say:6:1721702006:2.source_cn: 我……我潜入了那里的后厨……看到了一些违禁的食材……

say:8:1721702008:1.text: Gwyneth, you're a Royal Guard captain, not a petty criminal! What you did amounts to trespassing!
say:8:1721702008:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝！你是守备军的队长，不是市井的小偷。未经许可擅...

say:9:1721702009:1.text: ... Also, Magister Merlin and I have found a possible connection between Voracia and the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.
say:9:1721702009:1.source_cn: ……还有一件事，梅林阁下和我已经推断出——圣古堂的消失...
say:9:1721702009:1.male: ... Also, Magister Merlin and I have found a possible connection between Voracia and the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.
say:9:1721702009:1.female: ... Also, Magister Merlin and I have found a possible connection between Voracia and the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.

say:10:1721702010:3.text: Gwyneth explains to Hendrik the similar mechanism behind how dishes are served at Silken Snare and how the Hall of Ancients vanished, as well as the leads found by Merlin.
say:10:1721702010:3.source_cn: 格温妮丝向亨德里克仔细解释了传菜和传送圣古堂之间相似的...
say:10:1721702010:3.male: Gwyneth explains to Hendrik the similar mechanism behind how dishes are served at Silken Snare and how the Hall of Ancients vanished, as well as the leads found by Merlin.
say:10:1721702010:3.female: Gwyneth explains to Hendrik the similar mechanism behind how dishes are served at Silken Snare and how the Hall of Ancients vanished, as well as the leads found by Merlin.

say:11:1721702011:1.text: D-Does this conclusion come from Magister Merlin himself?
say:11:1721702011:1.source_cn: 这……这是梅林阁下确定的判断吗？
say:11:1721702011:1.male: D-Does this conclusion come from Magister Merlin himself?
say:11:1721702011:1.female: D-Does this conclusion come from Magister Merlin herself?

say:12:1721702012:1.text: Yes. While we have yet to determine Voracia's motive or identify the person behind her, all the leads we have so far point to her.
say:12:1721702012:1.source_cn: 千真万确。虽然我们还没查清她的动机和背后的主使，但现在...

say:13:1721702013:1.text: Father, please issue the order immediately! We can't afford any delay!
say:13:1721702013:1.source_cn: 父亲，下令吧！我们没有时间犹豫了！

say:16:1721702016:1.text: Without a search warrant, any evidence you've found is legally inadmissible.
say:16:1721702016:1.source_cn: 没有搜查令，没有正当程序，你们所看到的罪证在法律上是无效的。

say:17:1721702017:1.text: If we act hastily, Voracia could just say you planted the evidence and even file a counterclaim for abuse of power!
say:17:1721702017:1.source_cn: 如果我们现在冲过去，对方完全可以说是你栽赃陷害，甚至可...

say:19:1721702019:1.text: Now, I need to attend to something urgent. Don't think you're off the hook—we'll settle this later.
say:19:1721702019:1.source_cn: 我先临时去处理一个紧急公务。你擅闯民宅的事情，我之后再...

say:20:1721702020:1.text: Stay here and think about what you've done!
say:20:1721702020:1.source_cn: 现在，你给我老老实实待在驻地里反省，哪里也不许去！

say:21:1721702021:1.text: Where are you going? Now that we've identified the suspect—
say:21:1721702021:1.source_cn: 您要去哪？既然知道了嫌疑人——

say:22:1721702022:1.text: Stay here! This is an order!
say:22:1721702022:1.source_cn: 待在守备军驻地！这是命令！

say:24:1721702023:1.text: Without another word, Hendrik hurries out of the base.
say:24:1721702023:1.source_cn: 亨德里克没有再多做解释，就那样神色匆匆地离开了驻地。

say:25:1721702024:1.text: Gwyneth's suspicions deepen as she watches her father leave.
say:25:1721702024:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝看着那个迅速出行的背影，心中的疑云不仅没有消散...

say:26:1721702025:1.text: Something's not right. Father seemed like... he already expected what I found.
say:26:1721702025:1.source_cn: 太不对劲了，父亲的反应不仅仅是惊讶，更像是……知情者。

say:27:1721702026:1.text: No urgent reports came in today, and Father didn't bring anyone along. And the direction he was heading...
say:27:1721702026:1.source_cn: 没人报告临时的公务，父亲也没有带上副官及其他守备军，而...

say:28:1721702027:0.text: Since you're determined to hide the truth from me, I'll find out for myself.
say:28:1721702027:0.source_cn: 父亲，既然您不肯告诉我真相，那我就自己去看。

say:30:1721703001:0.text: Father's always been vigilant. I'd better not get too close.
say:30:1721703001:0.source_cn: 父亲小心谨慎，我得注意跟着的距离。

say:1:1721710001:1.text: Is Prince Orion really behind this?!
say:1:1721710001:1.source_cn: 此事竟然与王子有关吗？！

say:2:1721710002:1.text: I must find Magister Merlin at once and tell him about this.
say:2:1721710002:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下……我必须立刻找到<male>他</male>...
say:2:1721710002:1.male: I must find Magister Merlin at once and tell him about this.
say:2:1721710002:1.female: I must find Magister Merlin at once and tell her about this.

narration:0:1721711001:1.text: While Gwyneth is looking for Merlin, Merlin is also trying to find her...
narration:0:1721711001:1.male: While Gwyneth is looking for Merlin, Merlin is also trying to find her...
narration:0:1721711001:1.female: While Gwyneth is looking for Merlin, Merlin is also trying to find her...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1721708002:.text: I need to speak with Commander Hendrik in private.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1721708002:.source_cn: 我与亨德里克卿有事相谈

say:4:1721709001:0.text: Your Highness, pardon my unannounced visit. There are matters I must inquire of you in person.
say:4:1721709001:0.source_cn: 殿下，冒昧前来，是因为有些话，我必须当面问清楚。

say:5:1721709002:0.text: May I ask... what you and Magister Cyran did in the Hall of Ancients on the day it disappeared?
say:5:1721709002:0.source_cn: 圣古堂失踪的那天……您和迪尔格雷首席，在里面做了什么？

say:6:1721709003:0.text: Commander Hendrik, we simply paid our respects to my ancestors that day. Is there a problem with that?
say:6:1721709003:0.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，我不明白你的意思。那天我和首席只是祭拜了大...

say:7:1721709004:0.text: The chapel vanished along with Princess Peggy right after you left. That can't be a mere coincidence!
say:7:1721709004:0.source_cn: 这就是最大的问题。您前脚刚离开，后脚佩吉殿下进去就出了...

say:8:1721709005:0.text: ... Your Highness, I've known you since you were young. You have a good heart.
say:8:1721709005:0.source_cn: ……殿下，我看着您长大，我知道您本性纯良。

say:9:1721709006:0.text: But Cyran... he's been close with House Hastings and a handful of scheming nobles. It's no secret at court.
say:9:1721709006:0.source_cn: 但是迪尔格雷……那个老家伙跟黑斯廷斯家族，还有几个不安...

say:10:1721709007:0.text: Could they have exploited your trust to serve their own ends?
say:10:1721709007:0.source_cn: 不是他们利用您的信任，在圣古堂里动了什么手脚，甚至……...

say:11:1721709008:0.text: You're making baseless conjectures, Commander Hendrik...
say:11:1721709008:0.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，你的想象力很丰富。竟然有这种无端的猜测……

say:12:1721709009:0.text: As Commander of the Royal Guard, it is unwise of you to accuse the chief court mage and House Hastings without evidence.
say:12:1721709009:0.source_cn: 作为守备军司令，在这没有证据的情况下指控宫廷首席魔法师...

say:13:1721709010:0.text: ... Your Highness, our investigation has traced the matter to Silken Snare in the upper district. Its owner, Voracia...
say:13:1721709010:0.source_cn: ……殿下，现有调查已经追溯到了上城区的丝绒陷阱。那个名...

say:14:1721709011:0.text: She was invited to Savannah to open her restaurant by <style="highlight">Marquis Gervais</style>, the head of House Hastings.

say:15:1721709012:0.text: House Hastings, Voracia, and Cyran... They've cast their net far and wide.
say:15:1721709012:0.source_cn: 黑斯廷斯家族、法蒂玛、迪尔格雷……这张网已经织得够大了。

say:16:1721709013:0.text: Your Highness, whatever you're trying to do, it's not too late to turn back now!
say:16:1721709013:0.source_cn: 殿下，不管您是为了什么目的，或者受了谁的蒙蔽，现在收手...

say:17:1721709014:0.text: If things go too far, I'm afraid I can't speak in your defense before His Majesty!
say:17:1721709014:0.source_cn: 如果真的闹到不可收拾的地步，就算是我，也没法在陛下面前...

say:18:1721709015:0.text: Speak in my defense? Commander Hendrik, I think you're mistaken. I'm the future king of the Lightbearer Empire. I don't need anyone's "protection".
say:18:1721709015:0.source_cn: 保全我？亨德里克卿，您似乎搞错了一件事。我是耀光的王储...

say:19:1721709016:0.text: It seems that the investigation has worn you down, so much so that it's clouding your judgment...
say:19:1721709016:0.source_cn: 看来，最近这一连串的事情，确实让您太累了。累到让您开始...

say:20:1721709017:0.text: You should rest. I hereby excuse you from escorting me at today's royal hunt.
say:20:1721709017:0.source_cn: 既然您的心思已经不在守备军的正事上，那么，今日的皇家行...

say:21:1721709018:0.text: I'll assign someone else to handle security.
say:21:1721709018:0.source_cn: 我会安排人手接手防务。亨德里克卿，您还是留在驻地，好好...

say:23:1721709020:0.text: This is an order, Commander Hendrik. You are dismissed.
say:23:1721709020:0.source_cn: 这是命令，亨德里克司令。退下吧。

say:24:1721709021:0.text: ... As you command. I hope... you won't come to regret this.

narration:26:17021714:0.text: Orion and Hendrik send the others away. It seems they have something important to discuss.
narration:26:17021714:0.source_cn: 奥利安与亨德里克屏退众人，似乎要商量什么要事。
